active.detailsHtml:
Power BI customers might experience issues creating new Adobe Analytics connections and for existing connections where the customer has to sign in again. Engineers are actively investigating the issue, and an update will be provided soon.

As a workaround, customer can use Dataflows GetData to create a new connection and use it with Semantic model.
